verdict.rationale: Exporting chat history and account data is a fair trust-controls question for a consumer AI assistant like Kimi, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a chat-history or account-data export feature. The Admin API's billing, usage and audit-log queries are an adjacent developer-platform capability on the separate Open Platform, not a user data export.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can export my complete chat history and account data
